finding.claim: Unauthenticated insecure deserialization: Marshal.load on attacker-supplied base64 data in POST /restore allows remote code execution via a gadget chain.
finding.source: params[:state] from POST /restore (any unauthenticated remote client)
finding.guards_checked: No authentication, no signature/HMAC on the state, no class allowlist; single-file app with no middleware. Sinatra's default protections do not apply to deserialization.

verdict.reason: app.rb:6 passes Base64.decode64(params[:state]) from the unauthenticated POST /restore route (app.rb:5) straight into Marshal.load, with no auth, signature or class allowlist anywhere in the single-file app (the glob found only app.rb); the result is only inspected at app.rb:7, which does not prevent gadget-chain execution during load.
